exec: pm.test("Codigo HTTP 200 OK", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]));
pm.test("Content-Type es application/json", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("application/json"));
pm.test("El cuerpo es JSON valido", () => { pm.response.json(); });
pm.test("Respuesta en menos de 10 s", () => pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(10000));
const c = pm.response.json();
pm.test("id es un entero", () => pm.expect(Number.isInteger(c.id)).to.be.true);
pm.test("name es una cadena de texto", () => pm.expect(c.name).to.be.a("string"));
pm.test("display es una cadena de texto", () => pm.expect(c.display).to.be.a("string"));
pm.test("dataset_query es un objeto JSON (no nulo ni arreglo)", () => { pm.expect(c.dataset_query).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(Array.isArray(c.dataset_query)).to.be.false; });
const Ajv = require("ajv"); const ajv = new Ajv({ allErrors: true });

const schema = {"type":"object","required":["id","name","display","dataset_query"],"properties":{"id":{"type":"integer"},"name":{"type":"string"},"display":{"type":"string"},"dataset_query":{"type":"object"}}};
pm.test("Cumple el esquema de tipos (id, name, display, dataset_query)", () => { const ok = ajv.validate(schema, pm.response.json()); pm.expect(ok, JSON.stringify(ajv.errors)).to.be.true; });
pm.test("id corresponde a la pregunta solicitada", () => pm.expect(c.id).to.eql(parseInt(pm.variables.get("cardId"), 10)));
pm.test("name corresponde a la pregunta de referencia P1", () => pm.expect(c.name).to.eql("QA - Pedidos con subtotal mayor a 100"));
pm.test("dataset_query referencia la base de datos de la instalacion", () => pm.expect(c.dataset_query.database).to.eql(parseInt(pm.variables.get("databaseId"), 10)));
